recentItems.description:
Mission 118 (2026) | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Kalyan Ram, Shalini Pandey | Indian Thriller Movie

Synopsis
While staying in Room 118 of a resort, Gowtham experiences a vivid, terrifying nightmare at 1:18 AM. In the dream, he witnesses a young woman being brutally beaten by a group of thugs and thrown against a painting. Though he initially dismisses it, the exact same dream haunts him months later when he encounters the same room and time setup.
Driven by his investigative instincts, Gowtham suspects the vision is a form of lucid dreaming tied to a real-life crime. Assisted by his fiancée Megha (Shalini Pandey), he begins piecing together the fragmented clues from his dream. His investigation leads him to discover that the woman in his nightmare is Aadhya (Nivetha Thomas), a real person who has mysteriously vanished.
As Gowtham digs deeper into Aadhya’s past, he uncovers a massive, dangerous corporate conspiracy involving a medical scam orchestrated by powerful elites. The second half of the movie transitions into a race against time as Gowtham uses his journalistic skills and physical grit to expose the culprits, bringing closure to Aadhya's tragic fate.

recentItems.description:
Watch Jaandaar, the Hindi dubbed version of the Telugu action thriller Panjaa, starring Power Star Pawan Kalyan and Jackie Shroff in powerful roles.

Synopsis
The Protagonist: Jai (Pawan Kalyan) is an orphan taken in and raised by Bhagawan (Jackie Shroff), a powerful mafia don in Kolkata. Jai grows up to become Bhagawan's most trusted, lethal enforcer and hitman.
 A Double Life: Outside of his underworld work, Jai tries to maintain a sense of peace by running a flower nursery with his friend Chotu and falling in love with a Greenpeace activist named Sandhya (Sarah-Jane Dias).
The Turning Point: Bhagawan's biological son, Munna (Adivi Sesh), is an arrogant and psychopathic newcomer who commits a brutal atrocity by murdering an innocent woman (Jahnavi).
The Confrontation: Disgusted by Munna's cruelty, Jai confronts him and ultimately kills Munna in a fit of rage to avenge the innocent victim.
Loyalty vs. Morals: Enraged by his son's death, Bhagawan turns against his most loyal henchman. Jai is forced to go on the run, caught in a high-stakes battle for survival, redemption, and a final reckoning against his former mentor.

recentItems.description:
Watch Zakhmi Cheetah, the action-packed Hindi dubbed version of the Tamil movie Maanja Velu, starring Arun Vijay, Karthik, Prabhu and Dhansika.

Synopsis
The Honest Cop: ACP Bose (Karthik) is a sincere police officer investigating a massive 100-crore illegal bank loan fraud involving a ruthless land dealer named Umapathi (Chandrashekar) and corrupt officials like DIG Easwarapandian (Riyaz Khan).
The Setup and Murder: When the bank's chairman demands his money back after the deal collapses, Umapathi murders him and frames Bose for the crime. Umapathi and his henchmen later ambush and brutally kill Bose.
Brother's Vengeance: Bose's younger brother, Velu (Arun Vijay)—a college student who loves his classmate Anjali (Dhansika)—witnesses the aftermath and tries to save his brother.
Clearing the Name & Retribution: After public perception turns against Bose, Velu steps up to uncover the truth, dismantle the criminal network, eliminate the conspirators responsible for his brother's death, and rescue his family.
